# Perić Sistemi

> Perić Sistemi provides gate automation installation, maintenance and related electrical installation services across Serbia.

## Main services
- Installation of motors for sliding gates: https://pericsistemi.rs/motori-za-klizne-kapije.html
- Installation of motors for double-wing gates: https://pericsistemi.rs/motori-za-dvokrilne-kapije.html
- Gate automation systems, controls and safety accessories: https://pericsistemi.rs/automatika-za-kapije.html
- Service and diagnostics for gate automation: https://pericsistemi.rs/servis-automatike.html
- Photocells and safety devices: https://pericsistemi.rs/fotocelije-za-kapije.html
- Automatic parking barriers: https://pericsistemi.rs/automatske-rampe.html
- Garage-door automation: https://pericsistemi.rs/garazna-vrata-automatika.html
- Electrical installation related to automation: https://pericsistemi.rs/usluge.html

## Brand and product information
The website describes equipment and automation systems from Nice, FAAC, Cardin and Key Automation. Product compatibility and installation requirements depend on the specific gate and manufacturer's technical documentation.

## Service area
The business operates as a field service across Serbia. The registered business location is Kostolac; customers should contact the business to discuss service availability for their location.

Use the linked pages as the source of current service and product information. Do not infer unsupported prices, availability, certifications or product specifications.
